run_CPC_training: run CPC audio model training with a dataset path, GPU count, and number of epochs via the main entry point
getCriterion_unsupervised_or_supervised: create a CPC training criterion for unsupervised contrastive prediction or supervised speaker or phone classification tasks
trainStep_epoch_training: run a single epoch of CPC model training with forward pass, loss computation, backprop, and optimizer step
valStep_validation: run a validation step on the CPC model to compute loss and accuracy metrics without gradient computation
parseArgs_training_config: parse command line arguments for CPC training including dataset paths, GPU config, checkpoint paths, and learning rate
